instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark theme by default: Deep obsidian #0B0F14 base with neon warm amber #F59E0B and electric cyan #06B6D4 accents that evoke night grocery neon signs.
Import '@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk' for display/headings and '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans' for body in frontend/src/index.css.
Implement rock-solid French local SEO with Schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD in index.html/App.tsx.
Ensure client-side schedule calculation works reliably for night shifts spanning past midnight (18:00 - 05:00 next day).
FastAPI backend /api/shop route must serve shop metadata (hours, categories, phone, address, delivery zones, reviews) with graceful fallback on frontend if API is unavailable.
Always add data-testid on every interactive button, link, schedule row, and category card.
Mobile bottom sticky action bar is crucial for conversion when opened past midnight.
